resources.name: 19 - Capture authorized payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: insomnia.test('returns CAPTURED', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.json().status).to.eql('CAPTURED'); });

resources.name: 20 - Verify captured ledger balance
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const w=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('capture moves the held amount from wallet balance', () => { insomnia.expect(w.balanceMinorUnits).to.eql(45000); insomnia.expect(w.heldBalanceMinorUnits).to.eql(0); insomnia.expect(w.availableBalanceMinorUnits).to.eql(45000); });

resources.name: 21 - Create partial refund
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: insomnia.test('creates a refund record', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.json().amountMinorUnits).to.eql(5000); });

resources.name: 22 - Verify partial refund status
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const p=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('payment tracks partial refund', () => { insomnia.expect(p.status).to.eql('PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'); insomnia.expect(p.amountRefundedMinorUnits).to.eql(5000); });

resources.name: 23 - Refund remaining amount
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: insomnia.test('creates the final refund', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); });

resources.name: 24 - Verify fully refunded payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const p=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('payment reaches REFUNDED', () => { insomnia.expect(p.status).to.eql('REFUNDED'); insomnia.expect(p.amountRefundedMinorUnits).to.eql(20000); });

resources.name: 25 - Verify refund restores wallet balance
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const w=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('refund restores the original wallet balance', () => { insomnia.expect(w.balanceMinorUnits).to.eql(65000); insomnia.expect(w.availableBalanceMinorUnits).to.eql(65000); });

resources.name: 26 - Issuer decline - Create payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript:
insomnia.test('creates a payment scenario', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(201); });
insomnia.environment.set('issuer_decline_payment_id', insomnia.response.json().id);

resources.name: 26 - Issuer decline - Authorize payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const p=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('gateway scenario returns the expected result', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(p.status).to.eql('DECLINED'); insomnia.expect(p.issuerResponseCode).to.eql('05'); insomnia.expect(p.gatewayPaymentId).to.be.a('string'); });

insomnia.environment.set('gateway_timeout_payment_id', insomnia.response.json().id);

resources.name: 28 - Gateway timeout - Authorize payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const p=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('gateway scenario returns the expected result', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(p.status).to.eql('AUTHORIZATION_FAILED'); insomnia.expect(p.declineReason).to.eql('GATEWAY_TIMEOUT'); });

resources.name: 30 - OTP approval challenge - Authorize payment
resources.description: Run as part of the collection in listed order.
resources.afterResponseScript: const p=insomnia.response.json(); insomnia.test('gateway scenario returns the expected result', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(p.status).to.eql('PENDING_APPROVAL'); insomnia.expect(p.approvalReason).to.eql('OTP_REQUIRED'); insomnia.expect(p.issuerResponseCode).to.eql('65'); });
